name: Groveland
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Groveland, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Groveland, Florida for 2026: a tree lighting block party, the 35th Christmas Parade and a free Lake County Christmas.
lede: Groveland packs its Christmas into one December weekend at Lake David Park, then adds a free toy and photo night for Lake County families.
celebrates: The City of Groveland kicks off its holiday weekend on the second Friday of December with a Block Party and Christmas tree lighting at Lake David Park, with live music and the tree ceremony at 7 pm. The 35th annual Christmas Parade follows the next morning at the same park. A week later Empowering Young People holds Lake County Christmas at the Nathaniel Community Gymnasium with gifts, Santa photos, pizza and hot chocolate for local families. Marion Baysinger Memorial County Library adds a Santa storytime and a Christmas movie.
lastyear: Last year the Groveland Christmas Parade took place on Saturday, December 13, 2025, from 10 am to noon at 243 South Lake Avenue, and it was free, according to a Fun 4 Lake Kids listing. In 2026 the parade reaches its 35th edition on Saturday, December 12, from 10 am to noon at Lake David Park, and it follows the city's 2nd Friday Block Party and tree lighting the night before, on Friday, December 11.
facts: The Groveland parade reaches its 35th edition in 2026, according to the city's numbering, so it began in 1992. Lake David Park is the center of the city's holiday weekend: the 2nd Friday Block Party and tree lighting is on December 11 and the parade is on December 12. Groveland's library is named for Marion Baysinger and is part of the Lake County Library System.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Groveland itself, and we only list rides we can verify on a host page. Our Florida Christmas train rides guide collects the closest holiday train rides across the state for a longer day out. Eustis, a short drive away, has a trackless train for kids at Festive Friday in Ferran on December 11, according to the city's event page.

kidfact: Groveland's Christmas parade is old enough to be in its 35th year, so some parents once watched it as kids.
faq: With a Block Party and tree lighting at Lake David Park on December 11, a Christmas parade on December 12 and a free Lake County Christmas for families on December 19, hosted by Empowering Young People.
When is the Groveland Christmas Parade?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 am to noon at Lake David Park, according to the city's calendar.
Is there a free Christmas event in Groveland?
Yes, Lake County Christmas on December 19 is free for Lake County families, and toy recipients register through a link on the host's page.
The city's event pages give 243 South Lake Avenue in Groveland, and some pages show 450 South Lake Avenue, so check the map before you go.
Is there a library Christmas program?
Yes, Marion Baysinger Memorial County Library has a Visit with Santa Storytime on December 9 and a Muppet Christmas Carol movie on December 21.
